Donald Michie había trabajado durante la: Donald Michie had worked during the Second World War at Bletchley Park, deciphering German communications alongside Alan Turing, with whom he often argued about whether a machine could ever learn. Afterwards he was a biologist and, later, founded in Edinburgh one of the first artificial intelligence groups in Europe. MENACE, whose name plays on the word “menace”, has been rebuilt many times in classrooms and museums, because it teaches with matchboxes the same thing that far more complex programs do inside.
El perceptrón aprendía porque alguien le: The perceptron learnt because someone told it the correct answer at each example. This topic removes that help: all that arrives, at the end, is a reward or a punishment. The tools are [[pe-probabilidad|Laplace's rule]], the expectation of a random variable and total probability.
Empieza por el final: si quedan 4 y te t: Start from the end: if 4 remain and it is your turn, you lose, whatever you take.
En 1961, Donald Michie quería demostrar: In 1961, Donald Michie wanted to show that a machine could learn to play without anyone explaining the strategy to it. He had no computer to hand, so he built one out of what he had: 287 matchboxes, one for each distinct position in noughts and crosses, and a bag of coloured beads. He called it MENACE, and it learnt to play very well with a mechanism that fits in three lines: reward what ends well and punish what ends badly.
En 1992, Gerald Tesauro entrenó con refu: In 1992, Gerald Tesauro used reinforcement to train a backgammon program that learnt by playing millions of games against itself, up to the level of the best human players. In 2016, AlphaGo beat the champion Lee Sedol at go by combining neural networks with reinforcement learning, and its successor AlphaZero learnt chess, go and shogi starting only from the rules. Outside games, the same explore-or-exploit dilemma decides which advertisement to show, which version of a website to try or how to allocate patients between treatments in an adaptive trial.
En el aprendizaje por refuerzo no se dic: In reinforcement learning the correct answer is not given: only a reward or a punishment arrives at the end.

The best option is chosen in two ways: when there is no exploring, with probability $1 - \varepsilon$, and when there is exploring and chance falls precisely on it, with probability $\varepsilon \cdot \frac{1}{n}$. They add up because the cases are mutually exclusive: it is [[pe-condicionada|total probability]].
La mejor sale cuando no se explora, y ta: The best one comes up when there is no exploring, and also when there is exploring and chance picks it.
La probabilidad de una jugada depende de: The probability of a move depends on its numerator and on the total: raising or lowering the others moves it too. That is why a box converges so quickly towards what works.
La receta más sencilla se llama <strong>: The simplest recipe is called ε-greedy (epsilon-greedy). A small number ε is chosen: at each decision, with probability ε a random option is tried, and the rest of the time the one that has worked best so far is chosen.

Lo notable es que MENACE no sabe nada de: The remarkable thing is that MENACE knows nothing about noughts and crosses. It does not know what a line is, nor that the centre is a good square. Todo el que aprende por refuerzo se topa: Everyone who learns by reinforcement runs into the same dilemma. If you always do what has worked best so far, you exploit what you have learnt, but you will never find out whether something better was there. If you try new things, you explore, but you give up part of what you could already be gaining. It is the dilemma of choosing a restaurant: going back to the reliable one or trying the new one.
Todo esto tiene una formulación matemáti: All this has a mathematical formulation that turns the idea into a method with guarantees. Instead of asking what to do, one asks how much it is worth to be here, and that value satisfies an equation with itself, Bellman's, which is solved by repeating until it stops changing. A number also appears, the discount factor, which fixes how much a reward that arrives late counts and which can reverse the decision all on its own. It is in [[ia-refuerzo|Bellman and Q-learning]], together with what has to change when the states do not fit in a table.
